job_description: Job Responsibilities & Duties Office Location: Uttara, Sector-6, Dhaka, Bangladesh 1. Accounting & Financial Management Maintain daily accounting records and financial transactions accurately. Prepare, verify, and process vouchers, invoices, bills, and payment records. Maintain Cash Book, Bank Book, General Ledger, and Journal Entries. Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR). Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Prepare monthly Profit & Loss (P&L) reports and financial summaries. Monitor operational expenses and ensure proper supporting documentation. Perform product costing and L/C or sales contract closing cost analysis. Prepare monthly cost analysis and profitability reports for top management. 2. Payroll & Office Expense Management Prepare monthly employee salary sheets and maintain payroll records. Verify and process salaries, allowances, bonuses, and other employee payments. Review and process office expenses, conveyance bills, and reimbursements. Maintain supporting documents for all financial transactions. Ensure accurate payroll calculations and timely salary disbursement. 3. Banking & Financial Operations Prepare monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS). Monitor daily bank transactions, cash flow, and bank balances. Manage term loans, project loans, and machinery loans. Monitor bank liabilities, loan repayments, and export proceeds. Manage export proceeds realization and foreign currency remittances. Coordinate with banks regarding LC, loan facilities, and other financial operations. Monitor loan interest, installments, and banking charges. 4. VAT & Tax Compliance Prepare and submit monthly VAT Returns (Mushak 9.1). Maintain VAT registers and relevant Mushak documents. Prepare VAT reports and import/export-related VAT documentation. Prepare and submit quarterly withholding tax returns, as applicable. Prepare and submit annual income tax returns. Handle tax assessments, hearings, notices, and queries from tax authorities. Ensure compliance with applicable VAT and Income Tax laws and regulations. Maintain proper VAT and tax records for audit and regulatory purposes. 5. Import & Export Documentation Handle all import and export-related financial and commercial documentation. Maintain L/C documents, sales contracts, EXP forms, and banking records. Monitor export proceeds realization and foreign currency remittances. Coordinate with banks, C&F agents, suppliers, buyers, and other stakeholders. Maintain import costs, export expenses, and commercial records. Verify import and export documents to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance. 6. Inventory & Store Management Monitor inventory levels and maintain accurate stock records. Maintain purchase registers, stock registers, and inventory documentation. Supervise store and inventory management activities. Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. Monitor purchases, sales, material consumption, and stock movements. Ensure proper inventory valuation and reporting. 7. Bond & Customs Documentation Maintain and update Bond License documents and records. Handle bond-related documentation and regulatory compliance. Maintain UD (Utilization Declaration) and UP (Utilization Permission) records, where applicable. Maintain stock registers and bonded warehouse records. Prepare and submit bond-related reports to relevant authorities. Coordinate with Customs and Bond Commissionerate. Ensure proper documentation for import, export, and bonded warehouse operations. 8. RJSC & Regulatory Compliance Prepare and submit annual returns and statutory filings to RJSC. Ensure compliance with applicable Company Law and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and government authorities. Prepare and submit FDI reports to Bangladesh Bank, where applicable. Maintain statutory records and corporate compliance documents. Ensure timely completion of regulatory submissions and reporting requirements. 9. Accounting Software & Internal Control Operate Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime for accounting and financial transactions. Record and verify bills, vouchers, journal entries, and payment transactions. Manage accounts payable and receivable through accounting software. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Coordinate with Accounts and Internal Audit departments. Implement and maintain effective internal financial controls. Identify accounting discrepancies and take corrective measures. 10. Management Reporting & Financial Analysis Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports. Analyze operating expenses, product costs, and overall financial performance. Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis and cost variance reports. Provide financial insights and recommendations to top management. Assist in budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and business decisions. Monitor financial performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Ensure timely completion of accounting, financial, and statutory deadlines. 11. Audit & Financial Coordination Coordinate internal, external, statutory, and tax audits. Prepare audit schedules, financial statements, and supporting documents. Respond to audit observations and implement corrective actions. Maintain proper documentation for financial and regulatory verification. Ensure transparency, accuracy, and accountability in financial operations.

Business: Handicap International (HI) is an international aid organization specializing in the field of disability. Non-governmental, non-religious, non-political, and non-profit making works alongside persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups, whatever the context, assisting and supporting them in their efforts to become self-reliant. Since its creation, the organization has set up programmes in approximately 60 countries and intervened in many emergencies. It operates as a federation made up of eight associations (Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the USA) that provide human and financial resources, manage projects, and raise awareness of Handicap International`s actions and campaigns.

Handicap International-Humanity & Inclusion (HI) has been working in Bangladesh since 1997, focusing on creating sustainable changes to ensure the rights and inclusion of people with disabilities in society. HI is an independent and impartial aid organization working in Bangladesh in poverty, exclusion, conflict, and disaster situations. With projects in different districts of the country, HI works not only with people with disabilities and other vulnerable populations but also with their families, their communities, and local humanitarian actors to respond to their essential needs, improve their living conditions, promote respect for their dignity and fundamental rights, and provide sustainability in its action. As one of the key organizations in the disability sector, HI has a wide range of projects that assist in promoting the inclusion of persons with disabilities and their issues in emergency and development contexts, building the capacities of local stakeholders, and reducing the impact of natural and human-made disasters. Particularly in Cox`s Bazar district, HI is providing services in rehabilitation, MH/PSS, SRH, protection, and inclusive education with an inclusion mainstreaming approach to refugees and host populations affected by the forcibly displaced undocumented Myanmar nationals. HI`s multi-sectoral mobile units (MU) and static method are currently working in 15 camps located in both Teknaf and Ukhiya Upazilas and surrounding host areas, providing comprehensive services in physical rehabilitation, primary health care, protection, and MHPSS. HI is currently implementing a development and humanitarian response project in Kurigram and Cox`s Bazar district through 3 project offices (Kurigram, Ukhiya, and Teknaf) and 2 coordination offices (Dhaka and Cox Bazar). Operational Thematic: Livelihood, Health and Rehabilitation, Protection, Inclusion, Education, and Atlas Logistics.

Presently, HI Bangladesh is implementing projects on integrating disability in community-based disaster risk reduction and response; economic empowerment of extremely poor persons with disabilities; mainstreaming disability in livelihood interventions; support to refugees and surrounding communities, capacity building of professional associations; and support to disabled people`s organizations, among others.

Ensure inclusive representation of women, young women, Fisherfolk and marginalized communities in the committees. Facilitate linkages between WCPCs and Union Parishads, Ward Disaster Management Committees (WDMCs), Union Disaster Management Committees (UDMCs) and other relevant institutions. D. Facilitate quarterly interface meetings between WCPCs and Union Parishads/local disaster management committees to ensure women's voices are reflected in local disaster response, climate adaptation and recovery plans. Facilitate the selection and organization of women entrepreneurs and livelihood groups based on project criteria.
